slides.purpose: Evidence beat 2 — Typography and design fidelity
slides.content_brief: Title the slide 'Typography that holds'. Explain that HTML slides use CSS for pixel-perfect typography: web fonts load reliably, kerning and line-height are precise, and there is no font-substitution problem. Bullet points contrasting CSS type control with PowerPoint's font embedding issues, with a callout featuring the 1,700+ Google Fonts available
slides.assumes: The audience has seen a PowerPoint deck where fonts broke on a different machine
slides.hands_off: CSS gives presenters typographic control that PowerPoint simply cannot match
